queryPlans.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE facet_probe(value, step) AS (
    SELECT (SELECT MIN(r.scholarship_type) FROM scholarship_snapshot_rows r JOIN scholarship_campaigns c ON c.slug=? WHERE r.batch_id=? AND c.status='published' AND c.public_data_approved=1 AND c.active_batch_id=r.batch_id AND c.revision=? AND r.scholarship_type>''), 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT (SELECT MIN(r.scholarship_type) FROM scholarship_snapshot_rows r JOIN scholarship_campaigns c ON c.slug=? WHERE r.batch_id=? AND c.status='published' AND c.public_data_approved=1 AND c.active_batch_id=r.batch_id AND c.revision=? AND r.scholarship_type>p.value), step+1
      FROM facet_probe p WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND step<16
  ), facet_values AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT value FROM facet_probe WHERE value IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_probe WHERE step=16 AND value IS NOT NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT r.scholarship_type AS value FROM scholarship_snapshot_rows r JOIN scholarship_campaigns c ON c.slug=? WHERE r.batch_id=? AND c.status='published' AND c.public_data_approved=1 AND c.active_batch_id=r.batch_id AND c.revision=? AND r.scholarship_type IS NOT NULL AND r.scholarship_type<>'' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_probe WHERE step=16 AND value IS NOT NULL)
  )
    SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM facet_values) AS total,
      (SELECT json_group_array(value) FROM
        (SELECT value FROM facet_values ORDER BY value COLLATE BINARY LIMIT ? OFFSET ?)) AS optionsJson
